title: Well-known south-polar craters
purpose: Compare six well-known south-polar craters (permanently shadowed floors, ice research), same week and requirements as GR-001.
sites_status: NAMED PLACES, NOT RECOMMENDATIONS. The sites are the IAU's official centre points of named south-polar features (data/sites/iau_extract.json). A crater centre is its floor, not its rim; NASA's Artemis III regions are 15 km areas on or near these features. The same mission window, requirements and settings as GR-001 are used so results can be read next to it. This definition is a DRAFT: it has not been through the convergence report or the Gate 2 checks, and it is not frozen.

selection_reasons.mission.start_utc: 2027-01-10 00:00 UTC, the round date already used by the recorded fixtures and RUN-001, inside the kernel, Horizons and DEM coverage; fixed before looking at any result (S-11, D-08). Not chosen to contain or avoid an outage.
selection_reasons.mission.duration_s: seven days, the scenario length used throughout
selection_reasons.requirements: scenario values (Sun 60 %, Earth 50 %), not mission rules
selection_reasons.terrain: primary DEM release recommended in D-01, 150 km radius, 0.1 deg azimuth step (D-05), 2 m mast
selection_reasons.sites: Named places chosen by hand from public NASA material before any terrain or illumination result was computed for them; coordinates are the IAU centre points, not tuned.

freeze_rule: Draft. It may change until frozen; once frozen it is never edited (see GR-001).
